comment: US Coinbase Financial Markets perpetual-style futures assumptions for short research. Not a live enablement file.
hours: 24/7 with weekly 1h break Friday 17:00-18:00 ET (assumption from Coinbase Derivatives pages)
fee_note: Coinbase Jul 2025 CFM perp launch post said fees as low as 0.02% per contract. Research default is 4 bps per side (8 bps RT) until we scrape a live CFM fee schedule from the funded account.
funding_note: CFM perps use a premium/funding mechanism. Historical series not in this repo. Research charges shorts 0.3 bp each 8h (~3.3%/yr if always short) and NEVER credits funding, so carry cannot manufacture the edge.
price_proxy: Coinbase spot USD 5m folded to 4h (data/raw/BTC_USD_5m.parquet, ETH_USD_5m.parquet). Basis vs BIP/ETP is unmodeled.
